item.title: Longmont’s Winter Walkabout brings 100-plus musicians to downtown stages for annual festival
item.description: Longmont’s Winter Walkabout Music Showcase returns with more than 50 performances across 16 downtown venues, inviting audiences to move through the Creative District on foot while discovering local musicians, unexpected spaces, and a full day of live music.

item.title: 20 Colorado airports to get $12 million for improvements
item.description: Colorado is building up its system of 76 airports, investing $12 million for everything from an observation area to safety upgrades.

item.title: Fire near Colo. 93, Coal Creek Canyon Road is 80% contained
item.description: A Saturday morning fire that has burned 20-30 acres near the intersection of Colo. 93 and Colo. 72 is at 80% containment, according to Arvada Fire.

item.title: Colorado Dugout Club enshrines Garren Estes, Carmen Rivas, Tom Smith into its HOF
item.description: Just last month, Garren Estes, former Monarch/Centaurus/Boulder coach Carmen Rivas, and former Fairview/Holy Family athletic director and local umpire Tom Smith were recognized for their impact on the game and were inducted into the Colorado Dugout Club Baseball Hall of Fame.

item.title: PHOTOS: Annual Goldens in Golden event in Golden, Co. Feb. 7th, 2026.
item.description: The Annual Goldens in Golden event, which featured thousands of Golden Retrievers and their humans in Golden, Colorado, on International Golden Retriever Day. Golden Retrievers and their humans were treated to pup-cups, numerous photo opportunities, contests, vendors, entertainment, parties and games.
